sandbachFocus: Sandbach United maintained their position at the top of the table with a devastating 6-0 away victory at Telford Town on Saturday. Kyle Foley starred with a hat-trick, while Kieran O'Connell, Robbie Hatton, and Jack Birchall also found the net in a commanding second-half performance. The Bach's clinical finishing and solid defensive display earned them a clean sheet, keeping them level on points with second-placed Eccleshall.
divisionWide: Eccleshall secured a 2-0 home win over New Mills through goals from Nicky Parker and Danny Glover, extending their impressive recent form and maintaining their challenge at the summit. Wolverhampton Casuals continued their excellent run with a 2-0 victory over Foley Meir (Kieran Cook and Leo Wood scoring), followed by a 1-0 midweek win at home against New Mills. AFC Bridgnorth defeated Stafford Town 4-1 away in an entertaining encounter. Allscott Heath thrashed Wednesfield Community 4-0 with George Cross scoring a hat-trick. Dawley Town won 3-1 away at Crewe with goals from Kane, Macca, and Cian Fenlon (a stunning volley), while Shawbury United claimed victory at Brereton Social with a 2-0 result. Bilston Town drew 1-1 at home to Cheadle Heath Nomads after conceding a last-minute equalizer. Barnton's match against Market Drayton Town was abandoned at 3-0 following a serious injury to a Drayton player. Alsager Town drew 0-0 at Widnes Town but fell to a 1-0 defeat at Bilston Town in midweek. Telford Town's season continues to struggle following their heavy defeat to Sandbach.
